description: This file defines an ApiClient class that provides basic HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) with Bearer token support and JSON encoding/decoding, used to interact with a backend API in a Flutter mobile application.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A minimal API client supporting bearer token authentication and JSON data handling.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Sets or clears the bearer token used for authentication in subsequent requests.

methods.name: _headers
methods.description: Builds HTTP headers including Content-Type, Accept, and Authorization if token is set.

methods.name: _u
methods.description: Constructs a URI with optional query parameters based on the base URL and path.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Sends an HTTP POST request with JSON-encoded body.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Sends an HTTP GET request with optional query parameters.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Sends an HTTP PUT request with JSON-encoded body.

methods.name: _decode
methods.description: Decodes the HTTP response, parsing JSON if status code indicates success; throws exception otherwise.
